sentences.en: Unlike his other writings, this book was not for scientists.
sentences.zh: 与他的其他作品不同，这本书不是为科学家写的。

sentences.en: The crane, unlike the dog, has never dreamed of flying.
sentences.zh: 鹤不像狗那样曾经梦想飞翔。

sentences.en: Unlike you, I don't make fun of people in public.
sentences.zh: 和你不一样，我不在公共场合取笑别人。
